# André Ringdorfer (苏文)

> André works on product initiatives for NVNM Digital, part of Inveniam, following MANTRA’s acquisition. His work spans AI and financial infrastructure, based in Hong Kong. He runs a team of AI agents from a Raspberry Pi that keep working around the clock. Before AI, he shipped crypto products. Before crypto, he worked in strategy consulting and corporate strategy across Europe and Asia.

Pages:
- [AI work](https://andre-ringdorfer.com/): the AI agents and projects.
- [Experience](https://andre-ringdorfer.com/experience.html): results, work history, education and languages.

## AI work
- The Forge: an AI engineer that works around the clock. It picks up tasks, writes the code and hands it in for review. Some of André's own products are partly maintained by it.
- GoodInGoodOut: a calorie tracker you talk to. Describe a meal and it logs every part of it. The iOS app is on its way.
- Portfolio dashboard: every account, wallet and position, pulled in automatically and aggregated into one live dashboard.
- AI video studio: generates video, then a second AI critiques every clip. Only the best takes make the cut.
- Smaller projects: Keepr (a personal CRM you text), AEO toolkit (makes websites readable by AI answer engines), Build-your-Bob (the shared framework behind his bots), Date Doctor, Polymarket monitor, DoomDraft.

## Strongest results (US dollars)
- Sherpa Stake: a staking platform he built; over US$1 billion in tokens staked at its peak.
- Chakra Pool: savings vaults he built and scaled; US$18 million+ deposited.
- HeliSwap: Hedera's first native crypto exchange, which he led; US$7 million+ in deposits within months, and a US$2.5 million Hedera Foundation grant he secured.
- Developer course with Metaschool: 7,000+ developers onboarded to MANTRA Chain.
- RWAccelerator with Google Cloud: founded and led it; picked 7 startups from 150+ applicants and took them to launch.
- ETHGlobal hackathons: US$14,000+ in prizes.

## Questions people ask (answers written by André)

### What is The Forge?
The Forge is André's AI engineer. It works around the clock: it picks up tasks, writes the code and hands it in for his review. Some of his own products are partly maintained by it.

### What is he building right now?
Mostly AI agents that do real work unattended: an AI engineer, a calorie tracker you talk to, a dashboard that pulls his whole financial portfolio into one view, and a video studio with an AI critic. A few more stay private.

### What does André do day to day?
André works on product initiatives for NVNM Digital, part of Inveniam, following MANTRA's acquisition. His work now spans AI and financial infrastructure. Alongside that, he builds his own AI tools and agents in Hong Kong.

### How does he use AI at work?
Spec first, then agents. He writes the requirements and the checks, and AI coding agents build against them. He also uses AI for fast research: competitive analyses, data catalogues and onchain investigations that used to take weeks.

### What has he built in crypto?
Chakra Pool (US$18 million+ in deposits), HeliSwap (a US$2.5 million Hedera Foundation grant and US$7 million+ in deposits), Sherpa Stake (an EVM staking platform he built, with US$1 billion+ in tokens at peak), LuckyStake (a staking app on MANTRA Chain, now retired), 7,000+ developers onboarded through a developer course he created, and US$14,000+ in ETHGlobal hackathon prizes. He also led RWAccelerator with Google Cloud: 150+ startups applied, and he picked 7 and took them to launch.

### Where did he study?
WU Vienna (top 10%), then a double master's at London Business School and Fudan in Shanghai, with an exchange semester at the University of Hong Kong. He speaks German and Mandarin natively.

### How can I reach him?
LinkedIn is the best way to reach André: linkedin.com/in/andre-ringdorfer. You can also explore his code on GitHub at github.com/ringman007.
